Sky News — published Friday 25 September 2026 00:18 BST

HEADLINE: Anti-migrant activist Danny Tommo charged with criminal damage over 'boat slashing'

FACTS:
- Anti-migrant activist Daniel Thomas, 37, known as Danny Tommo, has been charged with criminal damage and failing to disclose his phone PIN, police say.
- He was filmed appearing to slash a boat in the English Channel on Tuesday with a rescue crew member on board.
- The suspect, of no fixed abode, was remanded into custody to appear at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court on FRIDAY MORNING (25 September). [DIARY ITEM, verified by Hampshire Police via Sky.]
- Thomas founded the anti-migration group Patriot Platform. He appears to have filmed his own arrest in a video streamed on his channel on Wednesday night.
- Around 200 supporters, largely wearing black, gathered outside a police investigation centre in Basingstoke on Thursday evening believing he was inside. They arrived just before 6.30pm and chanted "free DT". After news of the charge was announced, the crowd dispersed peacefully.
- Hundreds of activists also gathered in Gosport on Tuesday after Thomas filmed himself going out to sea to try to intercept a dinghy carrying dozens of migrants. Hampshire and Isle of Wight Constabulary said three people had been charged after gathering at the marina where they thought the boat's passengers were due to arrive; six people were arrested during the evening.

QUOTE (Hampshire Police statement): "The charges follow an allegation made to police that damage had been caused to a boat in the Channel whilst an emergency responder was on board."
